lean.statement:
(v F : E → ℝ) (G : E → E) (K : Set E) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hv : tsupport v ⊆ K) (hF : tsupport F ⊆ K) (hG : tsupport G ⊆ K)
    (hv2 : MemLp v 2 volume) (hF2 : MemLp F 2 volume) (hG2 : MemLp G 2 volume)
    (hd : ∀ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ a : E,
      Integrable (fun x => ψ x * inner ℝ (G x) a) volume ∧
      Integrable (fun x => v x * fderiv ℝ ψ x a) volume ∧
      (∫ x, ψ x * inner ℝ (G x) a) = -∫ x, v x * fderiv ℝ ψ x a)
    (hweak : ∀ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ →
      Integrable (fun x => v x * (Δ ψ) x) volume ∧
      Integrable (fun x => F x * ψ x) volume ∧
      (∫ x, v x * (Δ ψ) x) = ∫ x, F x * ψ x) :
    ∃ K' : Set E, IsCompact K' ∧ ∃ φ : ℕ → SchwartzMap E ℝ,
      (∀ n, tsupport (φ n) ⊆ K') ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (φ n).toLp 2 volume) Filter.atTop (𝓝 (hv2.toLp v)) ∧
      ∃ hφG : ∀ n, MemLp (gradient (φ n : E → ℝ)) 2 volume,
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (hφG n).toLp (gradient (φ n : E → ℝ)))
          Filter.atTop (𝓝 (hG2.toLp G)) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (Δ (φ n)).toLp 2 volume)
          Filter.atTop (𝓝 (hF2.toLp F))
approved_definition_context: Finite-dimensional real Hilbert E with Borel measurable structure and canonical ordinary volume, including dimension zero. NNReal denotes nonnegative reals. All section instances belong to the contract.

MemLp f2volume means actual AE strong measurability and finite L2 norm. MemLp.toLp f is the actual L2 quotient with AE link to f. Lp F2mu is the true quotient; Filter.Tendsto atTop(nhds target) here means convergence in its norm topology, not pointwise/local convergence.

SchwartzMap E real is actual C-infinity rapidly decreasing real function on real E. Classical gradient/fderiv and Laplacian act on these smooth approximants; tsupport is topological support. The conclusion adds one common compact support Kprime and one sequence before all n/three limits. The explicit hphiG witnesses MemLp2 of the actual gradient, binding its quotient class.

The generic inputs are compact-supported pointwise real v,F/vectorG with actual volumeL2, all-real-C1 compact weak-gradient tests and all-real-C2 compact weakPoisson tests, both legal L1 products and exact integral equalities. No Sobolev/core/sequence certificate is an input. E0 is retained.

LinearPMap is the original real-linear partial gradient on its actual domain; exact D.graph characterizes C-infinity compact functions/gradients in weighted L2, IsClosable/closure/IsClosed have their actual meanings. The source fixes D before epsilon/f and one actual u before all chi.

Measure.tilted is actual exp(h)/integral(exp(h)) weighted normalized law with stated integrability/positiveZ. Kernel Markov/CondKernel and Measure.map/prod denote genuine measurable transition/disintegration/pushforward/product; stdGaussian is actual standard finite real Hilbert Gaussian. Reflected W_y=V((y+z)/2)+norm(z-y)^2/(8eta).

Generic MemLp proofs and source AE-linked vL/FL/gradL add no mathematical assumption; every limit uses the actual localized functions from the same u. Fiberwise choice of solutions/sequences is not a joint measurable selection. Ordinary volume graph approximation does not by itself certify weighted domain/core/BL/main/composition.
